text: Utility service agreements for 9.2 GW capacity are subject to final regulatory approvals.
summary: Utility service agreements for 9.2 GW of capacity serving the PORTS-Pike campus remain subject to final regulatory approvals.
notes: AEP Ohio transmission investment is stated as $4.2 billion by DOE and approximately $5.1 billion in the S-1; unreconciled. New 765 kV line and four substations are a separate docket.
confidence_note: Read in original. The transmission capex discrepancy is from secondary comparison and not resolved.
